name: Tsogo Sun Limited
summary: Tsogo Sun Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the gaming, entertainment, and hospitality businesses in South Africa. It operates through Casinos and Hotels, Limited Payout Machines, Other Gaming and Betting, and Corporate segments. The company owns and operates casinos under the Montecasino, Gold Reef City, Silverstar Casino, Emerald Casino, Suncoast Casino, Golden Horse Casino, Blackrock, Garden Route Casino, Mykonos, The Caledon, The Ridge, Emnotweni, Hemingways Casino, And Goldfields names.
